title: Natural injector mutation proposal
description: One structured mutation emitted by the injector. The model does not choose a harness dispatch kind or artifact class; the harness infers those from the requested drift type and the proposal's fields. Line numbers and definition spans are resolved by the runner.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the file the mutation edits.

old.description: Value present on disk before the mutation (path, symbol, or constraint).

new.description: Value present on disk after the mutation; null for a symbol delete or dependency removal.

symbol.description: Bare symbol or normalized dependency name, where applicable.

target.description: The exact token as written on the document line.

doc_line_text.description: The exact current document line that carries the stale claim.

target_claim.description: The single documented claim the mutation invalidates.

exemplar_ids.description: Ids of the bank exemplars that anchored target selection.
